messages.subject: Genome Information for Exon Array
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to find the Genome Information for the HuEx-1_0-st-v2. I've
performed a limma analysis at the transcript level, and now wish to find
which transcripts correspond to which gene, given the unitName (e.g.
2315251) I've tried getGenomeInformation but get the following error
message:

> gi<-getGenomeInformation(cdf)
Error in list("getGenomeInformation(cdf)" = <environment>,
"getGenomeInformation.AffymetrixCdfFile(cdf)" = <environment>, :

[2008-05-13 14:12:42] Exception: Failed to retrieve genome information
for this chip type: HuEx-1_0-st-v2
at throw(Exception(...))
at throw.default("Failed to retrieve genome information for this chip
type: ", chipType)
at throw("Failed to retrieve genome information for this chip type:
", chipType)
at getGenomeInformation.AffymetrixCdfFile(cdf)
at getGenomeInformation(cdf)

I have the following files:
\annotationData\chipTypes\HuEx-1_0-st-v2\HuEx-1_0-st-v2,core,A20071112,EP,monocell.CDF
\annotationData\chipTypes\HuEx-1_0-st-v2\HuEx-1_0-st-v2,core,A20071112,EP.cdf
\annotationData\chipTypes\HuEx-1_0-st-v2\HuEx-1_0-st-v2.probeset.csv
\annotationData\chipTypes\HuEx-1_0-st-v2\HuEx-1_0-st-v2.transcript.csv
\annotationData\chipTypes\HuEx-1_0-st-v2\HuEx-1_0-st-v2_probe_tab

> print(cdf)
AffymetrixCdfFile:
Path: annotationData/chipTypes/HuEx-1_0-st-v2
Filename: HuEx-1_0-st-v2,core,A20071112,EP.cdf
Filesize: 38.25MB
File format: v4 (binary; XDA)
Chip type: HuEx-1_0-st-v2,core,A20071112,EP
Dimension: 2560x2560
Number of cells: 6553600
Number of units: 18708
Cells per unit: 350.31
Number of QC units: 1
RAM: 0.66MB

I have sent the top few transcripts to NetAffx and got some info that way.

I also noticed when browsing help, the help file for the
AffymetrixCsvGenomeInformation subclass of GenomeInformation is missing
in my install. Is this a feature yet to be included or do I need to
reinstall?

Thanks in advance,

Steve

messages.author: 43e2e19dd6bd2992
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Genome Information for Exon Array
parts:
Hi Steve,

The information is under files like
'HuEx-1_0-st-v2.na24.hg18.transcript.csv' or what ever is the version
that corresponds to the cdf you are using. It's not contained anywhere
in the cdf nor is there any linking function or mechanism to retrieve
the information if you have the cdf.

You can obviously bring that file into R, and it probably isn't too big
since it's per transcript cluster. Even then, the item corresponding to
'gene' has to be parsed -- it's not a simple column within the text.
This is basically the file that goes with NetAffx.

Frankly the simplest thing to do (particularly for a few ids), is to
just grep the file. It can be done within R so you can keep the code in
one place (and return the output within R) with system().

Best,
Elizabeth
